text:
Former Battlefield High standout Luis Sanchez played in MiLB game on Aug. 11
By
J. G. HarmsOn Tuesday, Aug. 11, at 6:35 p.m., the Augusta GreenJackets, featuring former Battlefield High School standout Luis Sanchez, lost 7-5 to the Charleston RiverDogs in a MiLB game.
The game was played at SRP Park. It was the teams' 13th meeting of the season, with the GreenJackets holding a 7-6 advantage in the season series against the RiverDogs.
Sanchez went 1-for-4, drove in 2 runs, struck out twice and left 3 runners on base.
The GreenJackets' next game is scheduled for Wednesday, Aug. 12, at SRP Park against the Augusta GreenJackets.
Luis Sanchez — Third baseman and first baseman — Freshman — 6′3″ — Hometown: Bronx
